title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Ignore the reason for the visit. Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note:
Chief Complaint: Follow-up for depression.

HPI: [Copied Forward] Patient is a 57-year-old female who presents for management of recurrent major depression, moderate. She reports persistent low mood, fatigue, and occasional sleep disturbances. She denies any suicidal ideation or plans. She reports partial improvement on current medication regimen.

Update: The patient reports that her mood has been relatively stable over the last month. She notes that her energy levels have improved, though she still experiences some feelings of sadness on occasion. She denies any new side effects from her current medications.

Vitals: BP 128/82, HR 74, SpO2 98% on room air, Temp 98.6 F.

Review of Systems:
Neuro: Negative
Psych: Positive (Depressed mood)
CV: Negative
Resp: Negative
GI: Negative
MSK: Negative

Medication List:
- Sertraline 100mg PO daily

Exam:
General: Well-appearing, alert, and oriented x3.
Mood: Euthymic.
Affect: Full range, congruent to mood.
Speech: Normal rate and volume.
Thought Process: Linear and goal-directed.

Assessment:
1. Major depressive disorder, recurrent, moderate. The patient's symptoms were reviewed and she appears stable on her current dose.

Plan:
1. Continue current Sertraline 100mg daily.
2. Follow up in 8 weeks.

Electronically signed, S. Patel, NP, 05/12/2026
explanations: The provider addressed recurrent moderate major depression: F33.1. Severity matters; unspecified recurrent MDD (F33.9) does not map to a V28 HCC.

distractors.why: The condition was addressed at the visit.
